🎥🎬: Lanterns (2026)

John Stewart, a former Marine recruited into the Green Lantern Corps, is paired with veteran Lantern Hal Jordan. Their relationship is complicated from the start, as Hal takes an unconventional approach to training John while knowing that his younger partner may eventually replace him. 

Their assignment takes them to Rushville, Nebraska, where they investigate a mysterious murder. What initially appears to be a small-town case soon reveals an extraterrestrial connection, hidden secrets, and a dangerous threat involving the Manhunters. 

Years later, John returns to Rushville and discovers that Hal has been mysteriously killed. Taking Hal’s power ring and following clues left behind by his former mentor, John sets out to uncover who murdered him and finally finish the investigation that began years earlier.
